name: Ur
summary: A structural demo record used to exercise the atlas place, source, Scripture-reference, and journey systems. Batch 2 will replace this summary and its supporting evidence with the researched Genesis record.

confidence.explanation: This record is deliberately marked as demo content. The application supports a distinction between identification confidence and interpretation confidence; Batch 2 will document the scholarly case and alternatives.

name: Haran
summary: Demo place record for the northern Mesopotamian stage of the patriarchal story engine. The final atlas will include ancient names, external gazetteer IDs, archaeology, period context, and citations.

confidence.explanation: Batch 1 is testing the confidence UI rather than publishing a completed scholarly assessment.

name: Shechem

confidence.explanation: The architecture is ready to hold external IDs and bibliography, but Batch 1 intentionally keeps source claims minimal.
